cases.answer:
- RAG-Sequence uses the same retrieved document to generate the entire answer and does not change or switch documents during answer generation; it treats the retrieved document as a single latent variable for the whole sequence [1][2].
- RAG-Token, in contrast, can use a different retrieved document for each output token, allowing it to change the document it draws from while generating the answer; each token may be generated based on a different latent document [1][2].
- Therefore, RAG-Sequence cannot change the retrieved document while generating an answer, but RAG-Token can change the retrieved document from one token to the next [1][2].
